about: Two-way radio failure under IFR, 14 CFR 91.185: the route in the rule's order (c)(1), and when to leave the clearance limit (c)(3). Web: lib/lostComms.ts. iOS: LostComms in PilotLogic.swift.

routes.label: Assigned
routes.rule: The route assigned in the last ATC clearance received.

routes.label: Vectored
routes.rule: Being radar vectored: direct from the point of radio failure to the fix, route or airway specified in the vector clearance.

routes.label: Expected
routes.rule: No route assigned: the route ATC has advised may be expected in a further clearance.

routes.label: Filed
routes.rule: Neither assigned nor expected: the route filed in the flight plan.

leaveLimit.words: Begin the descent or the approach as close as possible to your estimated time of arrival, from the filed or amended time en route.
